ucs.title: [LLM] TA505 / Indrik Spider WastedLocker pre-encryption ritual: shadow-copy + boot-config + backup wipe within seconds
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Evil Corp / Indrik Spider impact chain in which WastedLocker (and its Hades / PhoenixCryptoLocker / Macaw successors) clear VSS shadow copies, disable Windows boot recovery, and wipe the wbadmin catalog from the same host within a tight window before encryption fires. Catches TA505's ransomware tradecraft pre-T1486.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","sc.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog -quiet*" OR Processes.process="*delete systemstatebackup*" OR (Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","sc.exe") AND Processes.process="*stop*" AND Processes.process IN ("*veeam*","*backup*","*sql*","*MSExchange*")))) by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=1m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | bin _time span=10m | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime sum(count) as events sum(distinct_bins) as distinctBins values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(parents) as parents by dest user _time | where distinctBins >= 3 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Window = 10m;
let RecoveryKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","delete backup"))
         or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("veeam","backup","sql","MSExchange","vss"))
    | extend ActionBucket = case(
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" or FileName =~ "wmic.exe", "VSS",
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "BCD",
        FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe", "Wbadmin",
        "ServiceStop")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ActionBucket,
              FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
RecoveryKill
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctActions = dcount(ActionBucket),
            Actions = make_set(ActionBucket, 10),
            CmdLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where DistinctActions >= 3   // VSS + BCD + Wbadmin / ServiceStop within 10m = Indrik Spider pre-encrypt
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 10m;
let RecoveryKill = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend Image = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
    | where (Image endswith "\\vssadmin.exe"  and (Cmd has "delete shadows" or Cmd has "resize shadowstorage"))
         or (Image endswith "\\wmic.exe"     and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete")
         or (Image endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"  and (Cmd has "recoveryenabled" or Cmd has "bootstatuspolicy"))
         or (Image endswith "\\wbadmin.exe"  and (Cmd has "delete catalog" or Cmd has "delete systemstatebackup" or Cmd has "delete backup"))
         or (Image has_any ("\\net.exe","\\net1.exe","\\sc.exe") and Cmd has "stop" and Cmd has_any ("veeam","backup","sql","msexchange","vss"))
    | extend ActionBucket = case(
        Image endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" or Image endswith "\\wmic.exe", "VSS",
        Image endswith "\\bcdedit.exe", "BCD",
        Image endswith "\\wbadmin.exe", "Wbadmin",
        "ServiceStop")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ActionBucket, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
RecoveryKill
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctActions = dcount(ActionBucket),
            Actions = make_set(ActionBucket, 10),
            CmdLines = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where DistinctActions >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query:
source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:(4688 OR 1)) (
  (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"resize shadowstorage"*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*)
  OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"* OR *"delete backup"*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\sc.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\SC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*stop* AND @CommandLine:(*veeam* OR *backup* OR *Veeam* OR *MSExchange* OR *sql*))
) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.rationale: The simultaneous VSS+BCD+wbadmin+backup-service-stop sweep is the documented Indrik Spider / Evil Corp pre-encryption ritual carried across Dridex→BitPaymer→WastedLocker→Hades→Phoenix→Macaw. Single-vector queries (only vssadmin, only bcdedit) drown analysts in legit admin work; requiring ≥3 distinct recovery-disable action buckets from the same host/user inside 10 minutes is the specific tradecraf

ucs.title: [LLM] TA505 / Hive0065 Get2 → SDBBot loader: HTML/Excel lure spawning rundll32 from user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts TA505's signature initial-access chain: a phishing-borne HTML/Excel/Word attachment opens a downloader (Get2) that drops the SDBBot RAT, which TA505 executes via rundll32.exe loading a DLL from %APPDATA%, %TEMP% or %PUBLIC% with a custom export. The Office-or-browser → rundll32 → user-writable-DLL pattern is uniquely characteristic of TA505 loaders (Get2, FlawedAmmyy, SDBBot).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","outlook.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","msiexec.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe") (Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*") (Processes.process="*.dll*" OR Processes.process="*.tmp*" OR Processes.process="*.dat*" OR Processes.process="*,*" OR Processes.process="* /*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | regex cmdline="(?i)rundll32(\.exe)?\s+[\"']?[A-Z]:\\\\Users\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(AppData|Downloads)\\\\|[\"']?[A-Z]:\\\\(Windows\\\\Temp|Users\\\\Public|ProgramData)\\\\" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LoaderParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","msiexec.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LoaderParents)
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)[A-Z]:\\(Users\\[^\\]+\\(AppData|Downloads)|Windows\\Temp|Users\\Public|ProgramData)\\"
// SDBBot / Get2 / FlawedAmmyy land as .dll/.tmp/.dat with a custom export name; rule out IEFRAME / Office repair noise
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".dll",".tmp",".dat",".bin",".pdf") or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @",[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_@]{2,}"
| where not(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("shell32.dll","ieframe.dll","davclnt.dll","printui.dll","mshtml.dll","PrintUIEntry","OpenAs_RunDLL"))
| extend DroppedPath = extract(@"(?i)([A-Z]:\\[^\s,]+?\.(?:dll|tmp|dat|bin))", 1, ProcessCommandLine),
         ExportName  = extract(@"(?i)[\\\.\w]+,([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_@]{1,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DroppedPath = FolderPath + "\\" + FileName,
              DropperImage = InitiatingProcessFileName, DropperUrl = FileOriginUrl, DropSHA256 = SHA256
  ) on DeviceId, DroppedPath
| where isempty(DropTime) or DropTime between (Timestamp - 1h .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RundllCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          DroppedPath, ExportName,
          DropperImage, DropperUrl, DropSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: TA505 Get2/SDBBot rundll32 loader from user-writable path
id: 8e2bc5a4-ta505-rundll32-loader
status: experimental
description: Detects TA505 / Hive0065 loader pattern where Office, mshta, wscript, msiexec or browser spawns rundll32.exe pointing at a DLL/.tmp/.dat in %AppData%, %Temp%, %Public% or %ProgramData% with a non-standard export name. Maps to Get2, FlawedAmmyy and SDBBot delivery.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-06-19
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0092
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  selection_payload:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.dll'
      - '.tmp'
      - '.dat'
      - '.bin'
  filter_known_lolbins:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'shell32.dll'
      - 'ieframe.dll'
      - 'davclnt.dll'
      - 'printui.dll'
      - 'mshtml.dll'
      - 'PrintUIEntry'
      - 'OpenAs_RunDLL'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Installer cleanup routines from legitimate vendors that drop a DLL under ProgramData and immediately load it. Whitelist by signed parent + SHA256.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:(4688 OR 1)) @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\Rundll32.exe) @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MSIEXEC.EXE OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\Chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\MSEDGE.EXE OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\Firefox.exe) @CommandLine:(*\\AppData\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\*) @CommandLine:(*.dll* OR *.tmp* OR *.dat* OR *.bin*) -@CommandLine:(*shell32.dll* OR *ieframe.dll* OR *davclnt.dll* OR *printui.dll* OR *PrintUIEntry* OR *OpenAs_RunDLL*) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|wscript|cscript|mshta|msiexec|chrome|msedge|firefox|brave)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(AppData|Downloads|Windows\\\\Temp|Users\\\\Public|ProgramData)\\\\", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\\.(dll|tmp|dat|bin)\\b", field=CommandLine)
| NOT regex("(?i)(shell32\\.dll|ieframe\\.dll|davclnt\\.dll|printui\\.dll|mshtml\\.dll|PrintUIEntry|OpenAs_RunDLL)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| DroppedPath := regex("(?i)(?<DroppedPath>[A-Z]:\\\\[^\\s,\"']+?\\.(dll|tmp|dat|bin))", field=CommandLine)

| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, DroppedPath, ExportName], function=[count(), collect(CommandLine), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
